standards_claimed: Small Form Factor Pluggable Multi-Sourcing Agreement (MSA)
notes: Data rate table lists 1062–1250 Mb/sec; features cite 1.06 Gb/s Fibre Channel and 1.25 Gb/s Ethernet. Rx sensitivity -19 dBm @ 1.25 Gb/s (Gigabit Ethernet) and -21 dBm @ 1.06 Gb/s (1X Fibre Channel) per PRBS 2^7-1 at 10^-12 BER; Stressed RX sens. = 1.25 Gb/s is -14.5 dBm. Link length 10 km uses 0.55 dB/km attenuation and is dispersion-limited per FC-PI-4 Rev. 8.00 (indicative). Power: '<600mW typical' dissipation; Icc max 300 mA. Optical center wavelength λC table spans 1265–1600 nm; product is specified as 1310 nm Fabry-Perot. Transmitter total jitter TX Δ TJ is specified in ns (50–119 ns), not ps. Digital diagnostic Tx power monitor range -11.5 to -1 dBm; Rx -23 to +2 dBm.
